meta.name: Murderbot 2025
meta.description: In a high-tech future, a rogue security robot secretly gains free will. To stay hidden, it reluctantly joins a new mission protecting scientists on a dangerous planet... even though it just wants to binge soap operas.

videos.title: FreeCommerce
videos.overview: On a fresh assignment, Murderbot's newfound free will leads to odd behavior, sparking suspicion from the PreservationAux team.

videos.title: Eye Contact
videos.overview: Mensah and Bharadwaj risk everything to investigate a mysterious region. Gurathin goes toe-to-toe with Murderbot.

videos.title: Risk Assessment
videos.overview: The PresAux team heads to a new base to search for answers. Murderbot gets tangled up in a SecUnit showdown.

videos.title: Escape Velocity Protocol
videos.overview: As an enemy takes aim at Murderbot, an ally tries to orchestrate a getaway. The team grapples with a leadership shake-up and a shocking ultimatum.

videos.title: Rogue War Tracker Infinite
videos.overview: PresAux pulls out all the stops to forge a path forward. Tensions mount when trust is tested—and a DeltFall survivor joins the fold.

videos.title: Command Feed
videos.overview: A critical setback sends the team into a spiral. Mensah rolls the dice on a tricky procedure. LeeBeeBee changes her tune.

videos.title: Complementary Species
videos.overview: Murderbot deals with fallout and detects a critical threat. In hopes of evading danger, the team heads to a new locale full of surprises.

videos.title: Foreign Object
videos.overview: PresAux receives a dispatch from a rival group. Gurathin taps into Murderbot's bloody past.

videos.title: All Systems Red
videos.overview: Murderbot calls the shots at a critical rendezvous. Gurathin and Pin-Lee piece together a plan. Mensah makes her own move.

meta.slogan: Built to destroy. Forced to connect.
